# Research: lane-autonomy
<!-- Generated by /hef.plan Phase 0 -->
<!-- Date: 2026-11-03 -->

Two read-only truth-scouts (sonnet) built this map, splitting the questions between them; it is not an arena. The
baseline counts come from one four-lane project's orchestrator transcripts (6 days on 9.1.1).

## Baseline (the problem, measured)

- 34 forms and 36 `ledger.sh` permission dialogs in 6 days, all in the orchestrator.
- The dialogs by subcommand: approve 9, unblock 8, drop 5, answer 5, reopen 2, op close 2, op drop 2, supersede 1,
  release 1, fold 1.
- About 6 forms were product or design questions (for example "<item> gaps", "<field> keys", "Contract doc").
- About 9 were recovery decisions with an obvious default (Retry on a stall or verdict, "Builder resolves", "Build in
  the lane").
- 4 merges cost 8 forms (Merge, then "Irreversible: confirm") plus 4 approve dialogs.
- 2 were plan approvals; about 8 were lane-action approvals (mostly housekeeping).
- 1 asked for the approver's name.

## Relevant Symbols

- `hooks/ledger.sh:60` — PANES_DEFAULT routes verdict, stall, budget and conflict to the build pane, and human:* and merge to the orchestrator.
- `hooks/ledger-lifecycle.sh:38,90,154,203`, `hooks/ledger-actions.sh:304`, `hooks/ledger-recipes.sh:199` — `.events[]` appends, shape `{kind, at, by, note}`: the place for a `decision` kind.
- `hooks/ledger.sh:212` — GATES verify review quality scan mutate incident vulnerability. **No list of the gates required before a merge exists in code**; only command prose names them.
- `merge_by` is read nowhere in `hooks/`, only in `commands/hef.orchestrate.md:139`.

## Existing Patterns & Conventions

- A person's decision runs through a person sub: an `ask` rule in setup, `lane-guard` and `caller_gate` (orchestrator only), then `person_gate` (`--reviewed-by-human --by`).
- A trusted record is written only by `ledger.sh` into `~/.cache/hefesto`, which lane-guard and the sandbox keep out of a lane's reach.
- Every guard is mutation-tested, and assertions sit at the tool-call level (constitution 3).
- Helpers fail loudly with the evidence (constitution 5).

## Resolved Clarifications

- **Protected branches always ask** (person, 2026-11-03), where "protected" is the configured `branches.protected` plus main and master (person, plan review round 2): `ledger.sh branches`' effective set adds the integration branch by construction (`ledger.sh:113`), so the policy reads the configured list, copied by setup. A trunk project's main always asks; an unlisted `dev` integration branch can auto-merge.
- **New-setup default** `auto_merge: low-risk` (person); an existing project keeps what it has.
- **Merges asked twice**: the merge row at `hef.orchestrate.md:149` already passes `--irreversible-confirmed`; the second form comes from the orchestrator also applying the irreversible-scope rule `:186-188` to merges. That is a text fix.
- **`--by`**: today it is required except on a TTY (`ledger-lanes.sh:41`); a default from `git config user.name` closes it.

## Open Questions

- FR-001 (person-run probe): does a `PostToolUse` hook matching `AskUserQuestion` receive the person's actual selection, and can the model make it see a forged one (a pre-filled `answers`)? Docs: undocumented (claude-code-guide, 2026-11-03). FR-002 waits on it.
- Interactive lanes write their own verdicts through `--finish`, so a lane-reported "all PASS" is model-written. The plan's risk table covers whether auto-merge should trust only launcher-recorded verdicts.
